name: Fists
description: Your bare hands. Always available, rarely sufficient.

name: Rusty Shiv
description: Improvised scrap blade. Tetanus is a feature.

name: Cabal Sceptre
description: Ornate rod of the Cabal priesthood. Each strike discharges vortex energy.

name: Crude Pistol
description: Starter sidearm cobbled together from pre-war scrap. Good out to about eight tiles.

name: DreamBlaster
description: Mid-range energy weapon. Fires shimmering indigo bolts that disorient the target.

name: TerrorBlast
description: Heavy plasma cannon. Slow, intimidating, and deadly when it connects.

name: FortSlayer Deluxe
description: Siege-class rail rifle. Built to crack fortress walls and the mutants hiding behind them.
